metadata.title: LavorAI · Tailored job applications, under your control
metadata.description: LavorAI finds relevant openings, prepares a tailored CV and cover letter for each one and tracks every application. You decide when to send. From €19.99/month.

analizzaCvPage.subtitle: Start with your experience. Upload your CV, sign in with the link sent to your email and complete your profile to get started with LavorAI.
analizzaCvPage.caption: PDF · DOCX · up to 10 MB
analizzaCvPage.uploadBody: The upload form opens in the next step.
analizzaCvPage.howBody: Your CV first, then your profile. Set your preferences and review new applications before confirming them.
analizzaCvPage.step1: Upload a PDF or DOCX, enter your email and read the privacy policy before giving consent.
analizzaCvPage.step2: We send you a link to sign in securely and continue with the CV you uploaded.
analizzaCvPage.step3: After signing in, finish setup and set your preferences. Review and confirm new applications.
analizzaCvPage.finalTitle: Your next step starts with you.
